properties.description:
Support selecting multiple tasks in the Task graph. A right-click context menu action named Copy URL must copy the URLs of all selected tasks to the clipboard. Review selection and context-menu behavior with the user during development. Coordinate with Node editor batch operations because selection handling and Copy URL overlap.

Completed 2026-10-31: Implemented on master in 0fe8646. Ctrl/Cmd toggles task selection, Shift selects a rendered range, and right-click Copy URL copies all selected canonical URLs on separate lines. Right-clicking another task selects that task; keyboard selection is supported. Focused and full-sweep browser scenarios passed; screenshots reviewed. Node editor batch operations remain separate work.
Checkpoint: build, type/dependency checks and all 751 model/unit tests passed. The full browser sweep recorded 381 passes and two failures: the selector issue above (fixed and rerun successfully) and the pre-existing Windows newline recovery issue tracked separately in 5bb32ab9-aa94-4b84-bde6-6d059cfec2d4. Service rebuilt and restarted.
properties.title: Select multiple tasks in the Task graph and copy their URLs
